name: Subscriber controls
description: Reads only, 60 calls a minute, and 5000 calls a day for one subscribed application
prerequisiteMessage: Deploy Subscriber controls before the APIs that use it. A call is limited to GET, HEAD and OPTIONS, 60 times a minute and 5000 times a day.

steps.name: Reads only
steps.description: Allows GET, HEAD and OPTIONS. Other methods are refused.

steps.name: 60 calls a minute
steps.description: Limits how often one subscribed application may call

steps.name: 5000 calls a day
steps.description: Caps how many calls one subscribed application may make in a day
